gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/concern/prose/manifest.toml)

Checks ambiguous dates with bundled Vale styles at recommended; all adds the complete style and upstream packages.

## Why

Prose that hedges, markets or wanders is read by everyone who reads the code, and nothing else checks it.

## What to do

Rewrite the sentence the alert names, add a real name to prose.vocabulary, or use gspot ignore prose/vale --rule <rule>.

## Where it runs

- Preset: [the prose preset](/reference/presets/prose/)
- Stage: commit
- Level: recommended
- Engine: prose

Turn it off for a path with a reason: `gspot ignore prose/vale --paths <glob> --reason "<why>"`.
